REPORT
Date November 19, 1936.
Subject Activities of Jesse Fry.
Made by D.S. Jones. Forwarded by J. Boyce S.S.I.
Information has been obtained that Jesse Fry is
again in financial difficulties.
He is still residing at the Tower Apartments,
No.1033 Avenue Joffre, Apt. 22. For five months he has
not paid his room bill and is now in arrears to the amount
of $600. Whenever pressed for payment he asks for further
time, stating that before long he will receive from Washing-
ton the sum of approximately G$1,600 (sixteen hundred
American dollars) as bonus in respect of his war service
in the American army during the Great War. It should be
pointed out, however, that this sum represents approximately
the maximum amount the U.S. Government will pay to individual
war veterans. Whether Fry is entitled to so large a sum for
past services is not known. However, it is quite certain that
he will not be able to handle the actual cash realised by the
sale of any Government "baby" bonds which may be due to him
for war service until the end of next February. The reason
for this is that he did not send in his claim until November 2.
Even if this receives prompt attention on the part of the U.S.
authorities and the bonds are sent him by return of post,
these will still have to be sent back to America for disposal,
as there is no sale for such bonds on the local market.
Fry occasionally visits the Auditorium when the
Hai-Alai game is in progress. He is still unemployed and
nothing is known regarding his source of income, if any.
It has been learned that from February 6 to Feb. 17,
1935 Fry was in the General Hospital where he received treat-
ment from Dr. Blumenfeld for a "fistula ani." The hospital
bill of $223.40 has not yet been paid.
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH 19 NOV 1936 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

报告
日期：1936年11月19日。
主题：杰西·弗莱（Jesse Fry）的活动。
制作人：D.S. Jones。转呈人：J. Boyce，高级警司（S.S.I.）。
已获情报显示，杰西·弗莱再次陷入财务困境。
他仍居住在霞飞路1033号塔楼公寓（Tower Apartments）22室。他已经五个月未付房租，目前欠款达600美元。每当被催缴时，他便要求宽限时日，声称不久将从华盛顿收到约1,600金美元（即一千六百美元）的奖金，这是对他在一战期间于美军服役的奖励。然而需要指出的是，这笔金额大致相当于美国政府支付给个人战争退伍军人的最高限额。弗莱是否因过往服役而有资格获得如此巨额的款项，尚不得而知。不过，可以肯定的是，在明年二月底之前，他将无法处理因战争服役而可能归属于他的任何政府“婴儿”债券（"baby" bonds）出售所得的实际现金。原因在于，他直到11月2日才提交索赔申请。即使美国当局迅速处理并通过回邮将债券寄给他，这些债券仍须寄回美国进行处置，因为本地市场没有此类债券的交易。
弗莱偶尔会在海阿莱（Hai-Alai）赌博进行时前往大光明电影院（Auditorium）。他目前仍然失业，关于其收入来源（如果有的话）一无所知。
据悉，1935年2月6日至2月17日期间，弗莱曾在总医院（General Hospital）接受布卢门费尔德医生（Dr. Blumenfeld）对“肛瘘”的治疗。金额为223.40美元的医院账单至今尚未支付。
（印：特别处 1936年11月19日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）

Sir,
In amplification of the aforesaid reports, the following
information is now reported:-
Jesse Fry has a very chequered career and is a man of
mystery to any of his friends and acquaintances. It is
suggested that his biography, if ever written, would provide
some very interesting reading.
He has so far not come to notice as being a person, who
is actively engaged in the smuggling of narcotics. It is
rumoured, however, that his former servant named "Ah Fok" who
is reported to be now at Tientsin is said to have an opium den
there. It is doubtful, that Jesse Fry has any interest in
this business.
According to another report, Jesse Fry is said to have a
close friend in the person of a Captain of the Koller Co., and
is said to have been engaged together with the latter in the
smuggling of valuable tropical hard wood from the Dutch East
Indies. As there are no means of verification, this report
must be accepted with reservation.
Jesse Fry was formerly a man of means, but is said to have
squandered his whole fortune in gambling and excessive drinking
which caused his downfall.
During the Great War, Jesse Fry joined the Canadian Army
as a volunteer, and later, was transferred to the U.S.A. Army,
where he served with distinction, leaving the army with the
rank of captain in the reserve.
He is now about 52 years old and a widower; his late wife
was the daughter of a U.S.A. Consul at Paris. He had one son,
who died in the U.S.A. in a motor car accident.
I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
[Signature]

（左侧批注：）

先生，
作为对上述报告的补充，现报告如下情报：
杰西·弗莱的经历极为复杂，对于他的任何朋友和熟人来说，他都是一个神秘人物。有人建议，如果撰写他的传记，将会是非常有趣的读物。
截至目前，他并未被视为积极从事毒品走私的人员。然而，有谣言称，他以前的仆人名叫“阿福”（Ah Fok），据报现在天津，在那里拥有一家鸦片馆。杰西·弗莱是否与此生意有关联，值得怀疑。
根据另一份报告，据说杰西·弗莱与柯勒公司（Koller Co.）的一位船长关系密切，并据说曾与该船长一起从荷属东印度群岛走私珍贵的热带硬木。由于无法核实，对此报告必须持保留态度。
杰西·弗莱 formerly 曾是一位富有的人，但据说他将全部财产挥霍在赌博和过度饮酒上，这导致了他的落魄。
大战期间，杰西·弗莱以志愿者身份加入加拿大军队，后来转入美国陆军，在那里服役表现优异，退役时拥有预备役上尉军衔。
他现在大约52岁，是一名鳏夫；他的亡妻是当时驻巴黎的美国领事的女儿。他有一个儿子，在美国死于车祸。
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
[签名]

D.R.

REPORT
Date May 14, 1936

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File NO. REGISTRY
B. D. 1456）

Subject Activities of Jesse Fry.

Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by D. S. J. Coyne

After a long period during which he suffered acute
financial distress Jess Fry has suddenly blossomed forth as a
man of means. He has resumed his visits to the Auditorium and
it was there some three weeks ago that he attracted attention
by unexpectedly standing treat in the bar to many of the
former friends and acquaintances on whom he had sponged
during the past two or three years. When his supply of ready
cash - reported to be fairly considerable - ran out on this
occasion he induced the management of the Auditorium to cash a
cheque for three hundred dollars. Then, as though anxious to
display his newly acquired wealth, he is said to have made out
an additional cheque in the amount of three thousand dollars.
Both cheques were met when presented for payment the next
morning.

On April 20 Fry went to live at Hamilton House. When he
moved in he gave a cheque for six hundred dollars to the
manager of the Metropole Hotel and requested that the balance
be handed him in cash after the amount due for three days'
board and lodging had been deducted. The cheque was passed to
a Mr Campbell who took advantage of the opportunity to retain
not only the dues in respect of three days' accommodation at
Hamilton House, but also an additional sum of approximately
$300.00, representing an unpaid bill which Fry had owed the
Cathay Mansions for nearly three years and had evidently
forgotten. When Fry protested against this further deduction
he was advised to see Mr Campbell. However, he preferred to
send along a friend who collected what remained of the $600
after deduction of the amounts outstanding.

Fry left his quarters in the Hamilton House on April 24

主题：杰西·弗莱的活动。

制作人：D.S. Jones 转呈人：D. S. J. Coyne

在经历了长期的严重财务困境后，杰斯·弗莱（Jess Fry）突然以富人的姿态出现。他恢复了对大光明电影院（Auditorium）的访问，大约三周前，他在那里因意外地在酒吧为许多过去两三年里一直依赖他接济的老朋友和熟人请客而引人注目。当这次他那据报道相当可观的现金储备耗尽时，他说服大光明电影院的管理人员兑现了一张三百美元的支票。随后，仿佛急于展示其新获得的财富，据说他又开具了一张三千美元的额外支票。这两张支票在次日早晨提示付款时均获兑付。

4月20日，弗莱搬入汉密尔顿公寓（Hamilton House）居住。当他入住时，他向都城饭店（Metropole Hotel）的经理开具了一张六百美元的支票，并要求在扣除三天食宿费用后，将余额以现金形式交给他。该支票被交给一位坎贝尔先生（Mr Campbell），他利用这个机会不仅扣除了汉密尔顿公寓三天的住宿费，还扣除了另外约300.00美元，这笔钱代表弗莱欠国泰公寓（Cathay Mansions）近三年且显然已忘记支付的未结账单。当弗莱抗议这一进一步扣款时，被告知其去见坎贝尔先生。然而，他更愿意派一位朋友前去，收取扣除未付款项后剩余的600美元余额。

弗莱于4月24日离开了他在汉密尔顿公寓的住处

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. S. B. D. 1356
Special Branch, S.S. Station,
REPORT
Date February 18, 1936

Subject Present activities and movements of Jesse Fry

Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by J.B. Ross D.C.

Jesse Fry is a man who, although without visible means
of existence, seems to get along pretty well. He is a frequent
visitor to the Hoi Alai game at the Auditorium in Avenue du
Roi Albert and is on good terms with many of the players. It is
said that he speaks fluent Spanish and some French and German.
Fry's source of income, if any, is not known, but it has been
whispered that he is in the White Slave traffic. Although Fry
has numerous friends and acquaintances these appear to know
very little about him. This is probably due to the fact that
even when under the influence of liquor Fry can never be
persuaded to talk about his personal affairs. Although Fry is
regarded as being an extremely intelligent man his intelligence
is not of the kind to safeguard him from the not infrequent
spells of near-poverty to which he has had to submit during
his sojourn in Shanghai. Some time ago he was practically
destitute and was being kept in board and lodging by an American
newspaper man named Alcott. The two got on very well together
until Fry, who was short of pocket money, decided to raise the
wind on some of Alcott's wearing apparel. When Alcott discovered
that Fry had had the indelicacy to pawn his one and only dinner
suit, not to mention a few other sundries, such as an overcoat
and a lounge suit or two he became annoyed and showed Fry the
door. This happened two or three years ago. The two men have
since become reconciled.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (CRIME BRANCH)）
（批：File J.B.R.）

Fry has never been so affluent as when he first arrived in
Shanghai. This was in 1930 and he was then known to be in
possession of at least ten thousand American dollars, a sum
which he squandered within a few weeks.

It is rumoured that Fry is indebted to various people

日期：1936年2月18日

主题：杰西·弗莱的当前活动和行踪

制作人：D.S. Jones 转呈人：J.B. Ross，副督察长（D.C.）

杰西·弗莱是一个虽然没有可见生计来源，但似乎过得相当不错的人。他是阿尔贝特国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）大光明电影院海阿莱（Hoi Alai）赌博场的常客，并与许多赌客关系良好。据说他能说流利的西班牙语，以及一些法语和德语。
弗莱的收入来源（如果有的话）不为人知，但有耳语称他从事白奴贸易。虽然弗莱拥有众多朋友和熟人，但这些人似乎对他知之甚少。这可能是因为即使在醉酒状态下，也无法说服弗莱谈论他的个人事务。虽然弗莱被认为是一个极其聪明的人，但他的智慧并不足以保护他免受在上海逗留期间不得不忍受的、并不罕见的近乎贫困的时期。不久前，他几乎身无分文，靠一位名叫奥尔科特（Alcott）的美国报人提供食宿维持生活。两人相处得很好，直到手头拮据的弗莱决定变卖奥尔科特的一些衣物来筹钱。当奥尔科特发现弗莱竟厚颜无耻地典当了他唯一的一套晚礼服，更不用说其他一些杂物，如一件大衣和一两套便服时，他变得很生气并将弗莱赶出门外。这件事发生在两三年前。此后两人已和解。

（印：副督察长（罪案科））
（批：归档 J.B.R.）

弗莱从未像初到上海时那样富裕。那是1930年，当时已知他拥有至少一万美元，这笔钱在几周内就被他挥霍一空。

有谣言称弗莱欠下许多人债务

June 13, 1930.）

Sir,
Reference the attached memo. concerning an
American citizen, one Jesse Fry.
He returned to Shanghai on or about April 14,
1930 from London and occupied a room at the Cathay Hotel
until May 27, 1930. Whilst domiciled in that establishment
he was in possession of a large sum of money, which he
spent freely. On one occasion he placed in the safe of
the Cathay Hotel for safe custody, a letter of credit
on the American Express Company for G.$10,000. His moral
conduct in the hotel was such, that the management was
compelled to draw his attention to the fact,,with the request
to desist or vacate his room. Fry elected to conform
with the latter part of the request and moved to the Hotel
Tiny, 181A Yu Yuen Road, where he is still residing.
The letter of credit for G.$10,000 is believed to
have been purchased in Paris and was in good order. The
whole sum of money was withdrawn from the local office
of the American Express Company in less than a month, which
fact caused Fry to become a source of amusement to that
office. Considerable sums were collected by "shroffs"
from foreign brothels in Kiangse and Soochow Roads, where
Fry spent several days whilst still renting the room at
the Cathay Hotel.
So far as can be ascertained, he is not occupied
in any legitimate business in Shanghai, and in spite of
diligent enquiries no information has been obtained which
discloses his source of wealth or his connection with arms
traffic.

先生，
关于所附备忘录，涉及一名美国公民杰西·弗莱 (Jesse Fry)。
他于 1930 年 4 月 14 日左右从伦敦返回上海，并入住华懋饭店 (Cathay Hotel)，直至 1930 年 5 月 27 日。在该饭店居住期间，他持有大量现金，并挥霍无度。有一次，他将一张面值为 10,000 金元的美洲运通公司 (American Express Company) 信用证存入华懋饭店的保险箱妥善保管。他在饭店内的品行不端，致使管理层不得不提请其注意，并要求其收敛行为或搬离房间。弗莱选择遵从后一项要求，搬至愚园路 181A 号的小酒店 (Hotel Tiny)，目前仍居住于此。
据信，那张面值 10,000 金元的信用证是在巴黎购买的，且手续完备。全部款项在不到一个月的时间内即从美洲运通公司本地办事处提取完毕，这一事实使弗莱成为该办事处职员的笑柄。在弗莱仍租用华懋饭店房间期间，他曾数日流连于江西路和苏州路的外国妓院，大量钱财被那里的“收银员” (shroffs) 收走。
据查，他在上海并未从事任何正当职业，尽管进行了详尽的调查，但仍未获得任何能揭示其财富来源或与军火走私有关联的信息。

（批注：谁
1930 年 6 月 13 日。）

副督察长（刑事侦缉处与特别处）

W. Moore.
